title: Nemotron-Cascade 2: Post-Training LLMs with Cascade RL and Multi-Domain On-Policy Distillation

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: How might post-training methods like cascade RL reshape AI’s role in complex, real-world systems?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Nemotron-Cascade 2 uses multi-domain on-policy distillation to enhance reasoning and agency with 3B active parameters in a 30B MoE model.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: What safeguards exist if such models are deployed without sufficient oversight in critical infrastructure or decision-making?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are integrating alignment checks and transparency layers to ensure safe deployment and mitigate unintended behaviors.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine a future where AI agents collaborate with humans in science, medicine, and governance with aligned values and accountability.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future hinges on balancing innovation with ethical foresight as models like Nemotron-Cascade 2 redefine AI capabilities.
